primary_sources.evidence_summary: The abstract describes a JEPA variant that models a predictive distribution over future latent states and exposes uncertainty-bearing latent forecasts. It is not a financial paper and does not discuss selective abstention or risk coverage.
primary_sources.limitations: Abstract-level evidence only; no financial calibration or abstention result is established here.
primary_sources.title: VJEPA: Variational Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures as Probabilistic World Models

primary_sources.evidence_summary: The abstract reports an ELBO-style variational JEPA with latent uncertainty quantification on tabular data. It supplies a direct JEPA-plus-UQ component source but not a financial or abstention-specific study.
primary_sources.limitations: Abstract-level evidence only; non-financial and not a selective prediction paper.
primary_sources.title: Var-JEPA: A Variational Formulation of the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture - Bridging Predictive and Generative Self-Supervised Learning

primary_sources.evidence_summary: The abstract combines JEPA-derived embeddings with latent generative inpainting and adaptive conformal intervals. It is a strong component overlap for uncertainty-aware JEPA-style prediction, but not a financial abstention paper.
primary_sources.limitations: Abstract-level evidence only; load forecasting rather than financial selective risk coverage.
primary_sources.title: SPLICE: Latent Diffusion over JEPA Embeddings for Conformal Time-Series Inpainting

primary_sources.evidence_summary: The abstract covers calibrated temporal prediction intervals for financial series including S&P500, Bitcoin, and Gold under shift. It provides direct financial calibration overlap without JEPA or selective abstention.
primary_sources.limitations: Abstract-level evidence only; no JEPA latent-distribution objective or abstention policy is claimed.
primary_sources.title: Temporal Conformal Prediction (TCP): A Distribution-Free Statistical and Machine Learning Framework for Adaptive Risk Forecasting

primary_sources.evidence_summary: The abstract reports financial calibration and selective abstention / risk-coverage behavior. It directly overlaps the financial abstention target but uses a different architecture family and explicitly simulated results rather than JEPA.
primary_sources.limitations: Abstract-level evidence only; no JEPA latent distribution and simulated-result caveat remains material.
primary_sources.title: FinAbstain: Uncertainty-Calibrated Multimodal RAG for Selective Financial Forecasting

primary_sources.evidence_summary: The abstract describes a Granger-supervised causal-aware gate that opens only when incremental text value is present for financial event forecasting. This is a direct mechanism overlap for the proposed causal relevance gate.
primary_sources.limitations: Abstract-level evidence only; no JEPA future-latent objective is included.
primary_sources.title: GS-FUSE: Granger-Supervised Gated Fusion and Multi-Granularity Alignment for Event-Driven Financial Forecasting

primary_sources.evidence_summary: The abstract covers causal and counterfactual macro-event text plus financial time-series fusion. It strengthens the event/causal overlap side for E-REPORT-02 without supplying JEPA.
primary_sources.limitations: Abstract-level evidence only; no JEPA or learned relevance gate identical to the proposal is claimed.
primary_sources.title: CAMEF: Causal-Augmented Multi-Modality Event-Driven Financial Forecasting by Integrating Time Series Patterns and Salient Macroeconomic Announcements

primary_sources.evidence_summary: The abstract reports event-conditioned crypto fusion with a lag-aware trust gate and fallback behavior. It overlaps freshness-aware external-event gating components for E-REPORT-02.
primary_sources.limitations: Abstract-level evidence only; crypto rather than broader financial JEPA and no JEPA objective.
primary_sources.title: CGCMA: Conditionally-Gated Cross-Modal Attention for Event-Conditioned Asynchronous Fusion

primary_sources.evidence_summary: The abstract uses horizon-conditioned JEPA future representations for event survival prediction including volatility regimes. It supplies a JEPA-to-event-prediction bridge source relevant to E-REPORT-02.
primary_sources.limitations: Abstract-level evidence only; not financial external-event fusion and no causal text relevance gate.
primary_sources.title: HEPA: A Self-Supervised Horizon-Conditioned Event Predictive Architecture for Time Series

primary_sources.evidence_summary: The abstract covers earnings-conditioned self-supervised financial prediction and post-event signal decay. It provides direct financial event-conditioning overlap for E-REPORT-02 without JEPA or causal gating.

primary_sources.title: Trading through Earnings Seasons using Self-Supervised Contrastive Representation Learning

primary_sources.title: SC-JEPA: Stabilizing Latent Predictive Learning for Time-Series Anomaly Prediction

primary_sources.title: CF-JEPA: Mask-free forward prediction with asymmetric encoder utilization for time-series representation learning
